text:
Ava: ok tiny weekend non-work post — meet Gary, my African land snail. took him for a micro-walk on my desk. attached pic 🐌
Devon: omg adorable
Priya: love his tiny antennae :heart_eyes:
Liam: is that a... glittery trail? :joy:
Ava: it’s just his slime. very artisanal.
Sasha: name pun: Sir Slimes-a-Lot :rofl:
Devon: can he access the VPN? :thinking_face:
Ava: only if we set him up with a leaf ethernet cable :leafy_green:
opsbot: reaction :snail: added by Priya
Ava: also he left a sticky-note path that now says "meeting at 3" lol
Priya: poll idea: Should we add 'snail break' to the micro-pets rota? yes/no
Liam: yes
Devon: yes from me too
Ava: and any snail-safe snack recs? googled cucumber but open to recs
Sasha: calcium = crushed eggshells, apparently
Priya: or cuttlefish bone powder from pet stores
Ava: noted! thanks. he also does a tiny head tilt when I hum Bohemian Rhapsody :notes:
Liam: must record
Ava: uploading: https://redwood-internal/photos/2164829000_gary.jpg
Devon: photo dropped. I am weeping slightly
Priya: :camera_with_flash: great photo
Sasha: omg the texture on his shell. 10/10
Ava: will bring Gary for 'desk drop' Friday afternoon if no one allergic to slime :grimacing:
Liam: i'd like to witness
Devon: count me in
Ava: ok adding a 15-min 'Gary visit' event to calendar. thanks for indulging my nonsense :blush:
Priya: best non-work interruption all week
